public_rationale: The records support all four personnel statements as contemporary observations. Sutskever's departure was announced in May, Brockman's leave was announced through year-end, Murati announced her departure on September 25, and OpenAI documented Altman's removal and return. Brockman actually returned in November. Support therefore depends on reading the parenthesis as his announced leave plan, which fits the post's present-tense personnel summary.
limitations: The eventual duration of Brockman's leave differed from the announced plan.
News reports supply Brockman's and Murati's announcements where readable primary statements were not obtained.
The assessment concerns the named personnel statements; it does not independently authenticate the photograph's left-to-right arrangement.

our_interpretation: Assess the four named personnel statements as they stood on September 25, 2024.

Read Brockman's duration as the publicly announced leave plan at publication, rather than a guarantee that he would remain away through December.
Read 'less than a year later' as the time between the referenced cover and Sutskever's departure.

criteria.contradiction_condition: A named personnel status, announcement date, or announced leave duration was inaccurate when the post appeared.
